profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Credit Acceptance
profile.summary:
Results-driven Computer Engineer with 17+ years of experience designing, developing, and implementing enterprise applications across the Marketing, Automotive, and Investment industries. Proven expertise in software architecture, microservices-based solutions, and cloud platforms, delivering scalable and efficient systems.

	•	Expert in enterprise software development, specializing in Core Java, J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, JPA, JMS, Hibernate, REST APIs, and Shell Scripting.

	•	Strong background in microservices architecture, successfully migrating and building large-scale distributed systems.

	•	Extensive experience designing and developing software architecture for global projects, collaborating with cross-functional teams.
	•	Proficient in Web API development and reusable programming libraries, optimizing code maintainability and scalability.

	•	Skilled in implementing design patterns to enhance software efficiency and maintainability.

	•	Experience with front-end technologies, including JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, and CSS.

	•	Deep knowledge of database modeling, PL/SQL programming, and Oracle-based systems.

	•	Proficient in application servers and cloud platforms, ensuring high availability and performance.

	•	Hands-on experience with messaging systems, including JMS, IBM MQ, and EJB.

	•	Skilled in UML diagramming, system documentation, and software design methodologies.

	•	Experience in disaster recovery planning and high-availability system implementation.

	•	Strong leadership and teamwork skills, mentoring developers and contributing significantly to project success.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: REST APIs · Jdk21 · Docker · Spring Boot · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and designed scalable and robust microservice-based solutions, successfully migrating multiple monolithic ecosystems to microservices, enhancing system performance, maintainability, and scalability.

• Led the full software development lifecycle for projects that involved both in-house and offshore Java development teams, ensuring high-quality, efficient, and scalable software solutions tailored to customer needs.

• Engineered and developed from scratch multiple complex software ecosystems, including both monolithic and microservices architectures, optimizing performance for high-demand applications.

• Championed a customer-centric approach, ensuring software solutions met business objectives while enhancing user experience and satisfaction.

• Developed reusable infrastructure and business components for large-scale applications, focusing on the automotive industry’s demands for big data processing, API integrations, and transaction auditing mechanisms.

• Collaborated cross-functionally with stakeholders, identifying key areas for improvement and driving innovation in existing applications and infrastructure.

• Researched and implemented cutting-edge development technologies, enabling continuous improvements in software architecture and development processes.

• Established and enforced software development standards, best practices, and documentation strategies to ensure long-term maintainability and team efficiency.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description: Skills: REST APIs · Spring Boot · Jdk 11

positions.title: Java - Murex Consultant
positions.description:
The Northem Merchant Bank (Afore Banorte XXI). 
Responsible to design and develop software solutions to solve business requirements of front, middle and back office processes to communicate Murex platform with external systems in real time.

• Analyzed business requirements to develop a new software architecture to support business interfaces among Murex platform and external systems. These implementations provided reusable software components to translate and communicate financial operations between different software platforms based on MQ, JMS, XML, XSL, Java, Oracle and Unix technologies.

• Configured Murex Limits Connector over MQ series and Exchange's MQ Tasks.

• Integrated Murex Limits Connector with external limits system.
 
• Designed and developed reusable software component based on Oracle, to follow up the interfaces execution and been capable to be invoked across Java, SQL and Unix processes.

• Designed and developed reusable systems infrastructure to perform the banking end of date procedure based on Murex processing script, Unix shell scripts, email notifications and PL/SQL. that implementation provided an ordered, standardized, faster and safe way to integrate Murex processing scripts executions into the banking procedures.

•  Designed database model to manage reusable software components and business processes.

• Created technical templates, to generate standardized documentation and contribute with the compliance of auditing procedures as well as development of manuals to transfer the technical knowledge among the team members.

positions.title: Solutions, applications and delivery Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible to solve technological requirements from business processes, designing, coding and implementing technical solutions. Tracking of the software development and change management processes for new technologies. Support and follow up to the released solutions (Sharing functions in the Project Management Office and Information Technology area).

• Created reliable and fast communication components to transfer financial information in real-time and on demand among local and global systems from New York, Netherlands and Mexico based on technology such as: TIBCO Business Works, MUREX, Java, J2EE, Oracle, UNIX, JMS and XML among others. These types of components avoid the risk of capital losses and improve the strewing of processes strategy.

• Designed, developed and implemented programming standards, software architecture and reusable components of infrastructure in order to produce standard code, reduce the time and cost of development and maintenance activities.

• Researched, implemented and managed open source software capable of managing the versions of code and documentation, including additional functionality to the current change management process. This software implementation promotes the centralization and controlled access to digital information, reduces storage size of physical resources and it offers license cost savings of US$32,200/year to the company.

• Obtained a software license from American Express free of charge. The license is used to extract detailed data information of the ING’s corporative cardholders’ expenses. Resulting in a saving of many analysis hours of the accounting activity and license cost savings of US$20,000.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Developer of enterprise applications based on J2EE technology, performing additional activities such as: analysis of business requirements, designing of technical solutions, applications support and team lead in software development phases of designing and coding.

• Walmart. Supported and maintained applications, performing activities based on Six Sigma methodology in order to improve current business processes and applications through the identifying and managing of risks, root cause analysis and attention to incidents (activities of coding for bug fixing were included as well).

• FedEx. Designed and developed the front-end of an application oriented to help the operative departments to follow up and conciliate the issued invoices in Latin America region. Integrated the client's developing standards with the new technological specification and collaborated remotely with the development leader in Miami Florida.

• Grupo Modelo (Anheuser-Busch InBev). Created and designed front and back end functionality of an electronic survey to receive the annual purchase estimations from the company’s global clients in order to decrease the clients’ response time. Application designed to work as reusable surveys generator instead of a simple survey in order to increase the return on investment.

positions.title: Systems analyst
positions.description:
Software designer and developer of banking business applications based on J2EE technology.

• Designed technical solutions based on the business analysis specification, creating inputs for the development area with the goal to generate coding standards, reduce the programming time and promote the knowledge flow among the team members.

• Leaded team of four software designers.

• Developed financial interfaces between end of date processes and the clearinghouse of electronic payments.

courses.name: Business English, International Language Academy of Canada

projects.title: Murex Interfaces
projects.description:
• Implemented Murex Limits Connector with algorithmically external system.
• Developed technical interfaces among Murex and external financial systems for Liquidations and buy-sell operations (Money Market, Guaranties, SWAPS and Derivatives).

projects.title: Software infrastructure
projects.description:
Designed and developed reusable software infrastructure based on Java, J2EE, Oracle and Unix shell technologies in order to build the core of new in-house applications in the company and define and implement the new software development standards, including components such as:
- JMS connectivity (including TIBCO EMS support)
- XSL transformations
- File managing (XML, properties, plain, PDF and XLS)
- JNDI connectivity
- LDAP connectivity, among others

skills.name: Murex: MxML, Workflows, Services configuration, MDRS, PS, formulas and Datamart
Java related: J2EE, EJB, JPA, JMS, Webservices, RMI, TIBCO, EMC Centera
Java related: XML, XSL, Log4J, XLS, Jasper Reports, Design Patterns, JDBC, JNDI
Java related: Servlets, Hibernate, Spring, Struts, JSF, Tiles, JQuery
Java related: Java Script, Ajax, Display Tag Lib, HTML and CSS
Java related: open 4GL, JACOB (Java-Microsoft Bridge), Java Mail, JSP
Programming languages: Java, PLSQL and UNIX Shell
Data Bases: Oracle, Informix and DB2.
Application Servers: GlassFish, WAS and Weblogic.
Versioning: SVN, TortoiseSVN, CVS, Visual SourceSafe, WinCVS and Power.
Diagrammed: SQL Data Modeler, StarUML, Rational rose and Visio.
